definitions: Very wealthy and comfortable surroundings; the state of being that they create.
Something desirable but expensive and that one can live without.
Not essential but desirable and enjoyable and indulgent.

blocks.text: Luxury is a rock band from Toccoa, Georgia. They began playing together as The Shroud at Toccoa Falls College in the early 1990s, and changed their name to Luxury just before signing with Tooth & Nail Records and releasing their debut album, Amazing And Thankyou.
Luxury was a power pop rock music band from Des Moines, Iowa that played together from 1977 – 1982. It released two 7" singles and one EP.
